{{Top|leg}}
'''Holo-memos''' were a form of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] communication. It was frequently employed by [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]]. While researching the disposition of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] uncovered the Advisor's holo-memos while infiltrating the [[trans-system data storage library]] on [[Halowan]] which he found the content to be both amusing and frightening.
